summary: A Yes vote amends the Oceanside city charter to require prevailing wage standards and project labor agreements on municipal public works projects.

wages.text: Measure R supports prevailing-wage rules and clarifies the city’s authority to use or require project labor agreements on public projects.
wages.quote: The proposed amendments to Section 303 will clarify the City Council’s ability to use or require contractors to enter into a Project Labor Agreement with clear taxpayer protections.

wages.text: The No side opposes amending Oceanside’s charter to align prevailing-wage rules with state law and clarify the council’s authority to use project labor agreements.
wages.quote: proposing an amendment to the Oceanside City Charter to conform prevailing wage and fair competition provisions for public works contracts with state law
